mission: NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) & Multi-Temporal SAR Time-Series
challenge: NASA Space Apps Challenge: Dancing with SARs

study_area.name: Great Rann of Kutch & Banni Savanna Basin

seasons.title: August Peak Monsoon: The Vanishing Inland Sea
seasons.ground_feature: 7,500 km² saltwater flood inundation across Kutch depression
seasons.key_physics: Specular forward deflection on micro-smooth calm water (< 0.8 cm roughness) creates an unmistakable dark radar null (-22.40 dB). Liquid water has high dielectric constant (78.2 εr).

ground_truth_stations.name: Khadir Bet Flamingo Nursery
ground_truth_stations.observation: Elevated island horst safe from land predators

seasons.title: October Post-Monsoon: The Savanna That Blooms
seasons.sensor: NASA-ISRO NISAR L2 GCOV (Frame 076, Track 063, Orbit 6563)
seasons.ground_feature: 2,500 km² Banni tropical savanna forage growth & Prosopis encroachment
seasons.key_physics: HV cross-polarization volume scattering. Horizontally polarized radar waves bounce between randomly oriented grass stalks, rotating into the vertical channel. Backscatter magnitude directly scales with aboveground dry biomass.

ground_truth_stations.name: Banni Savanna Pastures
ground_truth_stations.observation: Dry forage yield for 50,000+ Maldhari livestock

ground_truth_stations.name: Kalo Dungar Peak
ground_truth_stations.observation: Highest elevation basalt ridge geodetic anchor

seasons.title: January Winter Arid: The Ghost Ocean Beneath the Salt
seasons.sensor: NISAR 24cm L-Band InSAR & Radiometric Permittivity Inversion
seasons.ground_feature: Bone-dry halite salt polygon mirror, 38 cm subterranean brine table, and 1819 Allah Bund fault scarp
seasons.key_physics: Dry halite salt crust is non-conductive with low permittivity (3.18 εr), acting transparently to 24cm microwaves. Waves penetrate unhindered down to the liquid brine aquifer (68.5 εr). Repeat-pass InSAR detects sub-millimeter crust deformation across the 90 km 1819 earthquake fault.

ground_truth_stations.name: Subterranean Brine Aquifer
ground_truth_stations.observation: Liquid brine 38 cm underground guiding Agariya salt wells

ground_truth_stations.name: 1819 Allah Bund Fault Scarp
ground_truth_stations.observation: 90 km seismotectonic wall tracked with InSAR deformation
